# Synthetic failure capture after plan O, opt-in two_stage_v2 and the research Jev cap (audit/02)

Source commit c45ea07573720d16a4f1c446be6d7d0a72066d86 (owner-private decide-failure evidence; opt-in `questionLayout: two_stage_v2`; explicit research `limits.jevUsd` up to 0.15 USD; two_stage_v1 requests unchanged). Two independent captures were made on a clean tree with the generator (`node tests/support/generate-failure-fixture.ts <dir>`); they differ from each other only at 15 run-ID leaves.

Compared with the adopted failure-path-repair-facts-e6e2c67 capture, records differ only at 36 leaves: 15 run IDs, 20 instruction-source hash leaves (`decision/jev-decision.ts`, `local-grounding/jev-local-test.ts`, `v2/dialogue-v2.mjs` and `v2/jev-turn.ts` in each of the 5 scenarios) and the derived `identity.prompts` digest. In the metadata only `baseCommit`, `fixtureSha256` and the source hashes of `decision/bypass-acceptance.ts`, `decision/contract.ts`, `decision/jev-decision.ts`, `diagnostics/jev-shadow-eval/local-openrouter.ts`, `local-grounding/jev-local-test.ts`, `model-policy.ts`, `v2/dialogue-v2.mjs`, `v2/jev-turn.ts` and `v2/research-profile.ts` change (72 source files, all checked against the commit's files). These scenarios use the default two_stage_v1 layout and none of their decide() calls fails, so no failure record is produced and request payloads, behavior, schema, failure, clocks, policy, calls/sends and storage are unchanged. Existing 3 run-ID exclusions are unchanged.

Earlier fixture directories remain byte-identical. Only the current provenance target URL and its baseCommit literal move. No real API, Keychain, .env, study data or live run was used.
